headline: Sensex Recovers From Lows as Nifty Bank Hits Fresh High Amid Weak Global Cues

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Early trade sell-off triggered by profit-taking and weak global trends
Global market weakness influenced by a sell-off in AI-related stocks
Sentiments pressured as Federal Reserve signals point to potential rate hikes
Portfolio inflows and bear retreat helped drive a rally in the Indian Rupee
whatHappening: Sensex recovered 600 points from its day low, while Nifty Bank achieved a fresh high
Jewellery stocks fell for the third consecutive day led by Titan, Kalyan Jewellers, PC Jeweller, and TBZ
The Indian Rupee strengthened past 93 against the US Dollar in early trade
Newly listed companies contributed ₹32 trillion to the BSE total market capitalization in 2026
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened lower amid weak global cues, Fed rate hike signals, and profit-booking. However, markets witnessed a sharp recovery off day's lows with Nifty Bank touching a new peak. Jewellery stocks saw extended losses while the Rupee appreciated against the US Dollar.
